description: This file implements thread-local storage handling for a Callsign object within the WPEFramework Core namespace, providing functions to get and set the callsign associated with the current thread.

classes.name: CallsignTLS
classes.description: A class providing thread-local storage for callsign information, with methods to retrieve and set the callsign for the current thread.

methods.name: Callsign
methods.description: Returns the callsign associated with the current thread, or nullptr if none is set.

methods.name: Callsign
methods.description: Sets the callsign for the current thread.
